In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of
 the Code of Criminal Procedure read with Section 482 of the
 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection
 with Berhampore Police Station Case No.1503 of 2023 dated
 14.10.2023 under Sections 498A/307/376/511/506/34 of the
 Indian Penal Code.

And
 In the matter of : Xxxx
 - Petitioner.
 Mr. Jishan Iqubal Hossain
 ....For the Petitioner.
 Mrs. Subhasree Patel,
 Mr. Dipankar Mahata
 ... For the State.
2. Let a service be effected by the State through the Police Station concerned upon the victim within one week from date.

3. In addition to the aforesaid, the learned Counsel for the petitioner shall serve a copy of this application along with a copy of this order upon the Secretary, Calcutta High Court Legal Services Committee in course of this week, in order to enable the Secretary to obtain necessary instruction from the victim upon establishing a contact with the victim through the Secretary, DLSA concerned and ensure that the victim is represented on the adjourned date.
4. The victim shall be provided free legal aid service by the Calcutta High Court Legal Services Committee.
